stories.headline: Snap spins off Specs Inc. ahead of consumer AR glasses launch
stories.subtitle: Snap created a wholly owned subsidiary, Specs Inc., to run its augmented-reality smart glasses business as a distinct brand. Its first consumer AR glasses, Specs, are due later this fall — a rival to watch on the AR shelf.

stories.headline: Samsung's Android XR glasses open for pre-orders Nov. 12
stories.subtitle: Warby Parker confirmed pre-orders for Samsung's first Android XR glasses open Nov. 12, with deliveries from mid-December. The Gemini-powered glasses have a camera and audio but no display — and no price yet. Customers will compare them to Ray-Ban Meta.

stories.headline: Gentle Monster teases December launch for Android XR glasses
stories.subtitle: Gentle Monster says its Samsung- and Google-built Android XR glasses arrive this December, fronted by a Joaquin Phoenix short film directed by Jonathan Glazer. Pre-orders open Nov. 12 alongside Warby Parker's collection.

stories.headline: Apple patent sketches a pocket-computer headset
stories.subtitle: A patent published Oct. 22 describes a Vision-style headset that keeps only screens and lenses on the face, with the processor and battery in a pocket unit. No product announced — but it's Apple's answer to Vision Pro's weight problem.

stories.headline: XREAL Aura Android XR glasses open for orders at $1,099 launch price
stories.subtitle: XREAL opened orders for Aura, the first wired glasses running Google's Android XR, at a $1,099 launch price (list $1,279) through December. US, Canada and South Korea orders are live, Japan opens Nov. 2, with shipping from mid-November.
